mechanism: Indomethacin (NSAID) increases bleeding risk and reduces renal function, while nalmefene (opioid antagonist) may mask pain perception and opioid effects if co-administered with opioids; additive GI and renal toxicity possible.
action: Monitor for GI bleeding, renal function, and fluid retention; use lowest effective NSAID dose and consider gastroprotection; assess necessity of concurrent use.
